blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A 76-year-old woman was robbed of around P90,000 worth of cash and jewelry at her residence in Forbes Park, Makati, with police identifying a 25-year-old pedicab driver as the suspect. The incident was reported on Sept. 24, with the suspect allegedly stealing around P50,000 in cash and P40,000 worth of jewelry from the victim. “So our police in Makati are closely coordinating to identify weaknesses in the subdivision’s physical security and patrol setup. How the suspect was able to get in—that’s what we will look into,” Philippine National Police spokesperson Col. Allen Rae Co. said in a press briefing on […]...
